registration.energy_aggregation: mean of two independent groups, explicitly 32/128/512 total samples; each individual group is 16/64/256 and its MSE is reported separately
registration.reference_scope: independent actual SAPIEN SDK scene; the public PT adapter still rejects interior cameras
registration.native_material: opaque metal0 roughness1: existing dielectric GGX/Fresnel model retained, not mathematically pure Lambert
registration.reference_material: SDK opaque metal0 roughness1 specular0; no free correction factor to match native
registration.lighting_scope: two invisible finite parallelogram emitters completely inside six opaque walls; no wall removed for lighting
registration.seed_scope: independent base seeds; 1/4/16 progressive batches have equal budgets across base-seed groups; no temporal motion
registration.statistics_scope: seed-pair difference estimates stochastic noise; distance to PT also contains material/quadrature/truncation bias

reference.interface: direct public SAPIEN SDK rendering components, NOT public Phymeo PT session

linear.space: inverse-sRGB direct-control estimate; excluded from raw mean error/variance gates

device_profile.gpu_scope: Vulkan timestamps: TLAS build/update plus raster and fragment shadows, then attachment copies; not fragment-only time
device_profile.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final ownership is checked by telemetry

indirect.estimator: rho_d * sum(Li)/16; 4x4 stratified cosine hemisphere with hashed 23-bit open-interval jitter
indirect.environment_policy: replace the original diffuse IBL/SH term, never add a second copy
indirect.miss_policy: original HDR level0 radiance along sample direction, or uniform environment; zero if absent
indirect.terminal_lighting: bounded 16 primary paths; optional one cosine continuation at each first hit; replace that hit diffuse IBL, retain direct/specular environment; final hit never recurses
indirect.seed_scope: seed + capture-local pixel + 0-based batch; state changes reset batch zero
indirect.geometry_policy: shading-normal cosine distribution clipped by oriented true face; inward/degenerate sample=0, denominator stays16
indirect.combination: independent primary specular/diffuse lobes may share terminal shading; no additional bounce
indirect.limitations: 16 noisy samples; no denoiser, temporal history, multiple diffuse bounces or raw-HDR output attachment

studio.arithmetic_scope: FP64 host basis packed to FP32; not bitwise equivalence to SAPIEN FP32 quaternion/trigonometric evaluation

environment.quantization: same RGBE shared 8-bit mantissa decode as reference uniform HDR

studio.units: metres; relative linear radiance, not calibrated photometric lux
studio.evaluation: native resident studio shader; distinct estimator from SAPIEN reference path tracing

diagnostics.shadows: GPU fragment Vulkan hardware ray queries against BLAS/TLAS; primary visibility remains raster
diagnostics.display: clamp linear exposure to [0,1], then IEC sRGB once
diagnostics.readback: explicit synchronous host-visible staging after fence; actual flags in resident_readback when available
diagnostics.published_ownership: immutable CPU bytes; private resident host buffer may be reused after each copy
diagnostics.stage_execution: visibility raster + bounded indirect lighting/sensors + GPU linear mean/display compute
diagnostics.lifecycle_counts: DLL-wide owned contexts, frames, and explicit Vulkan handles; pools own descriptor sets

indirect.estimator: rho_d * sum(Li)/16; 4x4 stratified cosine hemisphere with hashed 23-bit open-interval jitter
indirect.environment_policy: replace the original diffuse IBL/SH term, never add a second copy
indirect.miss_policy: original HDR level0 radiance along sample direction, or uniform environment; zero if absent
indirect.terminal_lighting: bounded 16 primary paths; optional one cosine continuation at each first hit; replace that hit diffuse IBL, retain direct/specular environment; final hit never recurses
indirect.seed_scope: seed + capture-local pixel + 0-based batch; state changes reset batch zero
indirect.geometry_policy: shading-normal cosine distribution clipped by oriented true face; inward/degenerate sample=0, denominator stays16
indirect.combination: independent primary specular/diffuse lobes may share terminal shading; no additional bounce
indirect.limitations: 16 noisy samples; no denoiser, temporal history, multiple diffuse bounces or raw-HDR output attachment

progressive.sequence: seed + capture-local pixel + 0-based batch; 16 primary paths, at most one continuation each
progressive.scene_scope: one immutable scene/session; camera, transforms, effective directional lights, world, epoch and extent are checked
progressive.non_rgb: does not advance or replace RGB history

resident_environment_info.capture_scope: successful RGB captures with an uploaded directional environment; sky draw count is not foreground pixel count
resident_environment_info.snapshot: last live query; final GPU allocations are reported by teardown telemetry

resident_texture_info.capture_scope: successful RGB captures with bound texture instances, not visible textured pixel count
resident_texture_info.upload_scope: cumulative actual texture image and metadata GPU writes, including default white sentinel; excluded from geometry_upload_bytes
resident_texture_info.snapshot: last live query, not final allocation state; teardown verified by allocation telemetry

resident_indirect_info.capture_scope: successful captures/RGB captures; samples_per_pixel is a budget, not an actual ray/hit counter
resident_indirect_info.receiver_scope: instances with uploaded metallic<1 and positive base-color factor; image-zero pixels may emit no rays
resident_indirect_info.snapshot: last live query retained after close; allocation teardown uses resident telemetry

resident_readback.snapshot: last live query, not final mapping state; teardown verified by allocation telemetry
resident_readback.capacity_scope: logical Vulkan readback buffer capacity, not total VkDeviceMemory allocation size

resident_profile.scope: cumulative successful captures including warmup; excludes initial static geometry upload
resident_profile.gpu_scope: render timestamp interval: TLAS + raster + bounded one/two-bounce paths + GPU scene-linear mean/display compute + 4-byte status copy; copy interval: requested planes; explicit mean readback is separate
resident_profile.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final ownership is checked by telemetry

resident_telemetry.allocation_scope: this context explicit VkDeviceMemory allocations; not driver total VRAM
resident_telemetry.wait_scope: host wall time blocked in fence waits, including upload; not GPU kernel time

resident_ray_query_info.capture_scope: successful RGB-requested captures, not ray count or visible shadow pixel count
resident_ray_query_info.buffer_scope: logical AS and scratch buffer bytes; actual VkDeviceMemory allocation telemetry is separate
resident_ray_query_info.update_scope: each capture builds or updates TLAS, including two cameras at the same frame key
resident_ray_query_info.upload_scope: additional VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR records, 64 bytes per instance per capture; not the ordinary forward/inverse matrix buffer
resident_ray_query_info.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final allocation teardown is reported by resident telemetry
